An allowlist that can be extended by whoever trips it is not a gate: additions require Mahmood's authorisation and a reason.

Observed on staged tree 3128458bf0432845ee9e13ea3706166cfe38da72; the commit adds only what records the observation (this entry, the run-3 log in the evidence dir, and their renders). The three refusals are the designed RED state of the enforcement gate: (1) unit tests -- exactly the two tests that assert a served page passes the WHOLE gate (tests/test_gate.py::test_real_review_reproduces_and_passes_full_gate; tests/test_result_withdrawn.py[dapagliflozin-hfpef-hosp]), 1,429 passed; (2) the publication gate on 24 of 32 pages -- 41 result-change notices OPEN for the reviewer's countersignature (check_result_change_countersigned) and 11 pages whose every candidate primary row was set aside on P5 (check_primary_result); (3) the honest-state ratchet, whose pre-commit base resolves to HEAD~1 = 8f14f411 while HEAD == origin/main and therefore spans TWO landings (M2's and this one) -- against 38c04411, the served state and CI's merge-base once this commit exists, the same limb passes with 0 refusals (observed). It does not suspend any check on main: main accepts only a SHA whose CI verify passed, and this SHA will not pass CI by design.
hook_bypasses.why: A gate that is red on the 53 rows today cannot be committed under a hook that requires green; the alternative (an opt-in gate, or dropping rows to reach green) is the defect the gate exists to prevent. The tree is pushed red so the reviewer can decide with the artefacts in front of him.
